name: ModelVariant808_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant808_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (sparkles stream from a model part while the ambient light dims, then a spinning star comet flies from it to the opposing slot, drawing a fading trail; on arrival a glow bursts, embers rise and fall around it and a ring spreads out while the colour fades and the light comes back); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the sparkles, embers and ring and packs five texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 1 once when the comet arrives, 2 once the colour has faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-825 and 922 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
